title: Fecal DNA Extraction by Bead Beating
author: Chin Yee Tan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zvrf656

steps.title: Add reagents to tube
steps.instruction: For each 2 mL screw‑cap tube, add the following reagents:

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL PB buffer (volume not specified in source)

steps.title: Centrifuge to pellet debris
steps.instruction: Spin down the tubes for 5 minutes (00:05:00) at 4000 RPM in a microcentrifuge.

steps.title: Proceed to PCR purification kit
steps.instruction: Use the PCR purification kit to purify up to 10 µg of PCR products.

steps.title: Prepare QIAquick column
steps.instruction: Label a QIAquick column and place it in a provided 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Load aqueous phase onto column
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous top layer of the sample onto the column and centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Apply the aqueous layer to the column
Centrifuge for 1 minute (00:01:00) at 17,900 g (13,000 RPM) at room temperature

steps.title: Discard flow‑through
steps.instruction: After centrifugation, dump the contents of the collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer PE
steps.instruction: Add Buffer PE to the column and centrifuge to remove it.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 1 minute (00:01:00) at the same speed and temperature as before

steps.title: Repeat wash step
steps.instruction: Perform a second wash by repeating the dump and wash cycle.

substeps.instruction: Dump the flow‑through from the first wash
Centrifuge for 1 minute (00:01:00) at 17,900 g (13,000 RPM) at room temperature

steps.title: Final spin to remove residual buffer
steps.instruction: After the second wash and dump, spin the column and collection tube for 1.5 minutes (00:01:30) to remove residual wash buffer.

steps.title: Transfer column to clean tube
steps.instruction: Place each QIAquick column into a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Add elution buffer and incubate to release DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL Buffer EB (or water pH 7.0–8.5) to the centre of the membrane

steps.title: Centrifuge to collect eluate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column for 1.5 minutes (00:01:30) at 17,900 g (13,000 RPM) at room temperature.

steps.title: Quantify DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Quantify the eluted DNA using the Qubit dsDNA BR Assay kit; a Nanodrop may be used as an alternative.
